Name: Hops during spring
Author: AuraVeldt
Description:
Have you ever been upset that spring doesn't have a really rentable crop ?
Have you ever been upset that several very rentable crops are on summer ?

So here with this mod you can plant hops on spring, so you can have one rentable crop at each season.

The mod doesn't change the fact that you can plant hops at summer. So you can plant it at spring and keep it on summer if you want, just like coffee beans.
If you want to only be able to plant hops on spring :
[list]
[*]Open "crops.json" in the assets folder.
[*]Find the line with the number 302, it's the hops line.
[*]Change "spring summer" by the season you want. You can write only "spring", or you can add multiple season.
[/list]

If you want to modify other datas, or change season for others crops, you can do it on other lines.
Each number at the beginning of a line is an object data matching with a specific crop.

The list of the object datas with the objects matching is here :      [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Object_data]Stardew Valley Wiki : Object Data[/url]﻿

Informations to modify other datas than the season are here :      [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Crop_data]Stardew Valley Wiki : Crop Data[/url]﻿

Maybe I'll make possible to change these datas in an easier way later, but for now it's my first mod and it stay very simple.

If you have questions about it or if you find a bug, you can contact me.
